name: strata
display_name: Strata: an excavation as one graph
description: Question and carefully edit an archaeological excavation (Harris matrix, finds, periods, contradictions) held in one Relate graph file.
long_description:
Strata holds the full published record of Kenan Tepe (Open Context, CC BY 4.0): 3,280 stratigraphic units, the relations between them, 19,742 finds and the 268 places where the excavators' own records disagree. Ask what a unit seals, how two units relate and why, a date bracket, where a find came from. Edits (propose_relation, resolve_order, assign_phase, add_note) are checked against the stratigraphy in a transaction and refused, with the chain of records, when they contradict it; accepted edits are logged and can be reverted.

Your data stays in one file you can see: by default Documents/Strata/strata.rl, created from the bundled store on first run. Point the 'Strata store' setting at any other .rl file to use that one. The store_info tool always says which file is in use.

store.title: Strata store (.rl)
store.description: A Strata/Relate store file to use instead of Documents/Strata/strata.rl (which is created from the bundled Kenan Tepe store on first run). Edits are written to this file.
